# maui-pulse

- Problem: live session viewer for Nuvyntra Plugin.Maui.* data (network, queues, sync, permissions, health, leaks, crash breadcrumbs, session)
- NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/Plugin.Maui.Pulse.Cli
- GitHub: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/MauiPulse
- Docs: https://nuvyntralabs.github.io/toolkits/maui-pulse/
- Version: 1.0.0
- TFMs: net10.0 (dotnet tool)
- Install: `dotnet tool install -g Plugin.Maui.Pulse.Cli --source https://api.nuget.org/v3/index.json` then `maui-pulse listen`
- Commands: listen, attach, pull, queues, sync, incident, version
- Allow-list only: NetworkMonitor, NetworkDiagnostics, JobQueue, RetryQueue, OfflineSync, PermissionFlow, AppHealth, LeakAnalyser, Diagnostics, DeviceSession
- Do not `dotnet add package` into an app. Do not use instead of maui-dev or maui-perf. Do not parse logcat / Firebase / Sentry.
